acceptance: No-test, absent-test, broken-import, infrastructure, timeout, skip, wrong assertion and real assertion red/green fixtures; preserve scope/forbidden checks.
detail: Require one identical runnable regression on base/head; persist named expected assertion and full output/evidence reference; reject missing test/module/import, tool error, timeout and skip as red. A no-test documentation exception must be explicit. Exact field filters must not select untagged entries; separate deferred from runnable work.
title: Repair verifier accepts missing tests/infrastructure failures as defect witnesses
